source_extraction.method: Requires exactly one anchored SUBROUTINE/END SUBROUTINE pair per name, takes original text including body, records parent source SHA, line interval and slice SHA. Adapter adds a module/type/error handler around retained procedures.
source_extraction.adapter: Config contains exact referenced field union with explicit defaults. No production arithmetic rewritten. read_text newline convention matches current retained LF source; this does not claim universal CRLF byte preservation.
source_extraction.not_full_module: Only four source-selected procedures and adapter compile. No full module/WRF host or UDM procedure is called.

transport_oracle.source_association: Order2 native advect divergence has msftx; native RK applies msfty once. Per-cell ledger uses face arithmetic independently and weighted update with c1*(mu+mu_base)+c2. rdx=rdy=1,rv=rom=0; periodic face endpoints and input halos are encoded and checked.
transport_oracle.stage_identity: Stage1 updates scalar_1 from scalar_2; stage3 starts scalar_2=-777 and requires output from old scalar_1. Stage cases start separately; not a multi-stage trajectory.
transport_oracle.per_scalar: Each slot computes its own tendency and invokes scs=sce=im using selected array section; no shared tendency is incorrectly applied to both generic slots.
transport_oracle.weighted_budget: Area=1/(mx*my), positive layer coefficient=-dnw/g, mass W=c1*(mu+base)+c2. Periodic total closure <=1.5e-7, prescribed source budget checked independently, uniform tracer preserved and patterned raw sum must differ by>1e-6. Spatially varying maps discriminate area weighting.
transport_oracle.arithmetic_scope: Per-cell comparisons use declared relative3e-7/absolute0.1 bound and REAL32 captured operands; independent FV algebra is not exact native-kind/ULP replay.

boundary_oracle.source_proof: Native Y-start uses v<0 outflow; Y-end v>0 outflow; X-start u<0; X-end u>0. Zero goes to ccn_conc. Oracle mirrors these predicates through independently expressed side coordinates and checks all memory cells.
boundary_oracle.corner_and_source_safety: Y boundaries cover corners with clamped interior i, then X touches j2 only. All selected outflow sources lie in unchanged interior i2/3,j2; expectation from initial source is valid in this width1 fixture. Periodic_x disables X update and removes Y i-clamp.
boundary_oracle.untouched_cells: Complete storage roster checks halos, top interface and nonboundary interior equality to initialized unique values.
boundary_oracle.limits: Width1 isolated state; no general multi-zone/corner-alias evolution, MPI/halo exchange or host trajectory proof. Existing coldstart producer evidence is pinned source-only, not newly called.

qualifications.evidence: PD call uses mu_old=mu_new=mu1; mass weights therefore cancel. It exercises added fully coupled source and sc_tend reset, but would not distinguish PD old-mass/new-mass selection. Regular RK call does exercise unequal mass.
qualifications.requirement: Keep source-update-only wording, or add a separately discriminating unequal-mass PD arm before claiming that coverage.

qualifications.evidence: Stage1/3 start from prescribed old state independently; vertical flux zero, second-order horizontal centered stencil and no diffusion/PD limiter/monotonic-WENO path. Limits do not call this a full trajectory or PD advection test.

Two generic scalar slots can prove source-defined mass weighting. Static Registry/driver/boundary source pins do not authenticate input/restart or UDM internal population basis. No rho conversion or density-factor production correction follows from this fixture.

actual_execution_status: Parent executes O0/O2; this review does not inspect raw output or independently run controls. Runtime PASS must come from its separately pinned actual receipt, not this source review.
